caption_L1: This is a bar graph called Which of the following sources , if any , have you looked at specifically for advice on foreign travel during the coronavirus outbreak ?. A categorical scale starting at Airlines (e.g. via their social media/website/app and ending at World Health Organization can be found on the y-axis, labeled Response. Share of respondents is measured with a scale with a minimum of 0.00 and a maximum of 0.35 on the x-axis.
caption_L2L3: Approximately 1/3 of respondents had not used any of the sources for foreign travel advice, representing the most common answer. The NHS was the most commonly used source for travel advice, followed by news sources/outlets. Less than 5% of respondents used a source not listed.
